note: The one-button actions of DaVinci Resolve Actions. A new action is a script in this folder and one entry here: id, name, script, args (optional), about, menu (true: also installed into Resolve's Workspace › Scripts › Utility). The app runs it with Resolve's Python from outside (External scripting = Local); its last printed line is shown. Shortcuts are his, set in the window, kept in ~/.config/resolve-actions.json.

actions.name: Create Timeline
actions.about: A new timeline from the clips selected in the Media Pool, named after the first clip, nothing asked.

actions.name: Previous Page
actions.about: Back to the page used before this one; twice and you are back.

actions.name: Toggle HD / UHD
actions.about: The project (and a timeline with its own settings) flips between 1920x1080 and 3840x2160.

actions.name: Check everything
actions.about: Is Resolve up, does its API answer, which project, resolution, page, pages in the bar, scripts installed and current.
